assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is medically necessary
The service is used to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service is used to assess the efficacy of current management strategies
The indications support medical necessity under the member's benefit plan
